description: SmartPixels refit v3: angle-error tables (P0.3 v1a1e, barrel global-key and disc module-frame)

corrections.name: module_orientation
corrections.description: barrel module orientation sign from the angle table (0: unknown module, no table entry)

corrections.name: angle_barrel
corrections.description: barrel angle-table entry at the predicted signed incidence key s cotB / sqrt(1 + cotA^2): module-frame centre c (published-sigma units, sign included), width w, mode

corrections.name: angle_disc
corrections.description: disc module-frame angle-table entry at the predicted local key sign(cotB) sqrt(cotA^2 + cotB^2), facings pooled: centre c, width w, mode
